roleContext.jobDescription: Our analytics database is sold both as an on-premises product and as a hosted service, and it ships on a release train every two weeks. The Technical Program Manager for release engineering runs the release calendar, chairs the go/no-go meetings, tracks dependencies between the storage, query and console teams, and works to shorten the time a change waits between merge and release. Lead-time improvements are reported from the release tracker against a baseline quarter. The role also partners with the security team on the process for shipping urgent vulnerability fixes.

requirements.text: Runs a recurring release calendar and the go/no-go meetings for a multi-team software product.
Tracks cross-team dependencies and escalates blocked work to engineering directors.
Shows a measured reduction in merge-to-release lead time against a baseline quarter from the release tracker.
Coordinates the security-fix fast-track process and reports its use to customer account teams.
Holds a project management certification such as PMP or equivalent.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Technical Program Manager, Release Engineering

## Experience

- Ran the fortnightly release calendar for the database product at Corvid Data and chaired the go/no-go meeting with the leads of the storage, query and console teams.
- Kept the dependency board for the three teams and raised blocked items at the weekly engineering directors' sync.
- Introduced a merge-freeze checklist and an automatically drafted set of release notes; median merge-to-release lead time in the release tracker went from 19 days in Q1 2023 to 11 days in Q3 2023.
- Agreed a fast-track route with the security team so that critical fixes could ship outside the train once the security lead approved them.
- Earned the Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute in 2022.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the Q3 2023 release review deck, with a per-release chart of median merge-to-release lead time from the tracker (Q1 2023 median 19 days, Q3 2023 median 11 days), a method slide defining lead time from merge commit to tagged release, and the VP of engineering's comments.
